enemies: Damis (level 103, then level 174 in second phase)
rewards: Ability to purchase an Ancient Staff.

st.t: Talk to the archaeologist Asgarnia Smith in the Bedabin Camp, by the magic carpet. You can use the flying carpet service from the Shantay Pass to get here.
Talk to the Terry Balando in the Exam Centre found south-east of Varrock, directly south of the Digsite.
s: Ask about the Desert Treasure quest.

st.t: Talk to the Terry Balando again.
s: Ask about the Desert Treasure quest.

st.t: Bring the translation to the Archaeologist in the Bedabin Camp.
Talk to the Archaeologist again.
Unequip any god-related items you have on, or else you'll be attacked by bandits. Go buy a drink from the pub in the Bandit Camp, then talk to the Bartender again.
Talk to the bartender in the Bandit Camp again.
Talk to Eblis in the east of the Bandit Camp.
s: Tell me of The four diamonds of Azzanadra
Yes, I will go get those for you.

st.t: Use the items on Eblis in the east of the Bandit Camp. Items can be noted. Then talk to him again, and talk to Eblis at the mirrors south east of the Bandit Camp.

tr: Teleport to Bedabin Camp. Fairy Ring (BIQ), Camulet

st.t: Wear your facemask, then enter the smokey well west of Pollnivneach. You'll need to run a lot, so bring energy/stamina potions if you can.

Light all four torches in the corners of the dungeon with your tinderbox. The torches burn out on a timer, so keep running: north-east first, then south-east, then north-west, and south-west last, which is closest to the chest.
Open the chest in the middle of the dungeon.
Use the warm key on the gate in the east of the dungeon. Be prepared to fight Fareed. If you aren't wearing ice gloves he'll unequip your weapon.
Kill Fareed. Either use melee with ice gloves, or water spells. Recall that the mysterious stranger can appear and attack you whilst you're holding the diamond.

tr: Teleport to Pollnivneach. Pollnivneach house teleport

st.t: Talk to Rasolo south of Baxtorian Falls.
s: Ask about the Diamonds of Azzanadra

st.t: Bring antipoison, food, and as many lockpicks as you can to the Bandit Camp, and try opening the chest in the south of the Bandit Camp. Keep trying until you succeed.
Return the cross to Rasolo south of Baxtorian Falls.
Equip the Ring of Visibility, then go down the ladder in the area east of Rasolo. It's recommended you bring combat gear to safe spot Damis.

From the ladder, head east as far as you can, then north as far as you can. Go east again, and south as far as possible at the first fork. Go east again, take the next turn north, then go east into the large cave. Wait there for Damis to appear, with the ring of visibility still on.
Kill both phases of Damis. You can safespot him by attacking a bat and keeping the bat between the two of you.
Pick up the shadow diamond. Recall that the mysterious stranger can appear and attack you whilst you're holding the diamond.

tr: Teleport to the Waterfall. Skills necklace (Fishing Guild [1]), Games necklace (Barbarian Outpost [2]) (2)
Teleport to Bandit Camp (desert). Fairy Ring (BIQ), Camulet
e: Damis (level 103, then level 174 in second phase)

st.t: Talk to Malak in the pub in Canifis.
s: I am looking for a special Diamond...

st.t: Ask Malak in the pub in Canifis how to kill Dessous.
Go down the trapdoor west of Morgan's house in Draynor Village into the Draynor Sewers. Go east, then north, and talk to Ruantun to have your silver bar made into a silver pot.
Bank all weapons and armour first: they aren't allowed on Entrana. Sail to Entrana with the silver pot, go to the church and use the pot on the High Priest to have it blessed.
Bring the blessed pot to Malak in the pub in Canifis. He'll bite you for a small bit of damage.
Add the garlic powder to the blessed pot.
Use the spice on the blessed pot.

Use the blessed pot on the vampyre tomb in the Morytania Graveyard, south-east of Canifis and north of Castle Drakan. The Shades of Mort'ton minigame teleport and the Hollows boat (10 coins) are one way to get near. Be prepared to fight Dessous.
Kill Dessous.
Return to Malak in Canifis to get the Blood Diamond. Recall that the mysterious stranger can appear and attack you whilst you're holding the diamond.

tr: Teleport to Canifis. Fairy Ring (CKS), Fenkenstrain's teleport (3)
Teleport to Draynor Village. Amulet of Glory (Draynor Village [3]), Draynor Manor Teleport

st.t: If you walk from Burthorpe instead of teleporting, wear climbing boots. Go to Trollheim and take the north-western path past the thrower trolls (Protect from Missiles stops their damage). Don't take the path blocked by a boulder: it leads to the God Wars Dungeon.
Use a cake on the Troll Child by the Ice Gate.
Talk to the Troll Child north of Trollheim.
Enter the ice gate east of the troll child. Make sure you're prepared for combat, and your stats to be continually drained.
Kill 5 ice trolls.
Continue along the path through the cave to the east.
Continue along the path until you find Kamil. Kill him with fire spells. Get into melee distance and protect from melee.
Equip the spiked boots, then continue along the path until you reach an ice ledge. Climb up it.
Follow the Ice Path up to the top and enter the gate there.
Break the ice surrounding the trolls at the end of the path. Fire spells are effective for this.
Talk to the troll parents at the end of the Ice Path.
If the troll parents didn't give you the ice diamond, talk to the Troll Child north of Trollheim to get it. A mysterious stranger can appear and attack you while you hold the diamond.

tr: Teleport to Trollheim. Trollheim teleport, Ghommal's hilt (any tier)

st.t: Go to the pyramid south-east of the Bandit Camp and place each diamond in its own obelisk: blood in the north-west, smoke in the north-east, ice in the south-east and shadow in the south-west. You need 50 Magic. A mysterious stranger can appear and attack you while you hold the diamonds.
Bring any energy/stamina potions you have and some food. Climb the pyramid south-east of the Bandit Camp and go down the ladder at its very top. The south door only opens after the quest.

Go down the ladder on each level until you reach the bottom. Start running north on the first level, east on the second, south on the third and west on the fourth. Keep tapping ahead and don't stop: traps can throw you out of the pyramid, and then you start again.
Enter the central room of the bottom floor.
Talk to Azzanadra to finish the quest!

tr: Teleport to Jaldraocht Pyramid. Camulet, Pollnivneach house teleport
